commit.message:
8393009

Hi all,

  please review this fix to refinement duration calculation that unnecessarily subtracts yield time from sweep time. Sweep time does not contain yield time already; the `G1ConcurrentRefineSweepTask::work` code already only counts when it is running and it does not yield by itself. On yield request (in `G1RefineRegionClosure::do_heap_region()` it exits the whole task and depends on the controller to restart it.

Effect: sweep time is underestimated, card rate too high, and we potentially end up with more than expected cards in the pause.

Testing: gha

Thanks,
  Thomas
